h1: Contact Heart of Harmony Enquire for Pricing, Floor Plans & Site Visit

blocks.text: Whether you want to enquire about 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK or 4 BHK homes at Heart of Harmony , Hosur Road, or schedule a site visit to our experience centre at Kudlu Gate, our team is ready to assist. Reach us at +91 76499 99586 or fill the form below.

Heart of Harmony Experience Centre is located at Hosur Main Road (NH48), Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru 560068. From Silk Board junction, drive south on Hosur Road — the experience centre is approximately 10 minutes. Kudlu Gate Metro Station (Yellow Line) is 400 metres away.

Frequently Asked Questions Heart of Harmony Contact & Site Visit

items.q: How do I book a site visit to Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Call +91 76499 99586 or fill in the enquiry form on this page. Our sales team will contact you within a few hours to schedule a convenient time to visit the Heart of Harmony experience centre on Hosur Main Road, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru.

items.q: What are the Heart of Harmony experience centre hours?
items.a: : The Heart of Harmony experience centre is open Monday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Appointments are recommended but walk-ins are welcome.

items.q: Where is Heart of Harmony located?
items.a: : Heart of Harmony is located at Kudlu Gate on Hosur Main Road (NH48), Bengaluru 560068. It is 400 metres from Kudlu Gate Metro Station (Yellow Line) and 10 minutes by road from Silk Board junction.
